job.text: Look up each region's donations in 2022

source.shows: a missing value is no bar and a note saying so, sorted last (R0-12, R9-7, R9-9); at the text width the names cannot keep 1 em apart under columns, even with every multi-word name wrapped (“N. England” and “Gr. Lakes” do not break after an abbreviation), so the chart turns horizontal: bare numbers on the scale and its title below, “Donations ($K)”

the same chart at 480 pt, the narrowest width (in steps of 8 pt) at which every name keeps 1 em from its neighbours under columns, as the book draws it (p. 327); the currency and magnitude on the top label

reasons.chart.orientation: to set beside the columns the rule gives at this width

source.shows: the same chart at 480 pt turned horizontal by choice, a guided departure with its reason
